hook.name: VolatilityFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a realized-volatility fee on every swap in the pool's quote currency. The fee rate ranges linearly from a base to a maximum (1%–5.3%) based on how far the previous swap moved the price (tick delta). Fees are collected as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager and forwarded to an immutable fee wallet via a permissionless sweep function. Exact-output swaps are rejected.
